questions.question: Explain the term primary news source / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the term primary news source. / [CO1, CO2]
  • A primary news source is the original and firsthand source of information used in news
  • reporting. It includes eyewitnesses, interviews, official statements, press conferences,
  • documents, speeches, and direct observations by reporters. Primary sources are
  • important because they ensure accuracy, credibility, and authenticity of news.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the role of a journalist in society / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the role of a journalist in society. / [CO1, CO2]
  • A journalist plays a vital role in society by collecting, verifying, and presenting truthful
  • information to the public. Journalists inform people about current events, educate society
  • on important issues, expose corruption and injustice, and act as watchdogs of democracy.
  • They also give voice to the marginalized and help citizens make informed decisions.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the key characteristics of radio as a medium.
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the key characteristics of radio as a medium. / [CO1]
  • Radio is an audio-based medium that uses sound, voice, music, and sound effects. It is
  • immediate and allows quick dissemination of news. Radio is portable, affordable, and has
  • wide reach, especially in rural areas. It stimulates the listener’s imagination and does not
  • require literacy.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: List any three skills required for a general assignment reporter. / [CO3, CO4]

• List any three skills required for a general assignment reporter. / [CO3,
  • CO4]

questions.question: Why should a newspaper follow consistency in language?
questions.solution_html:
• Why should a newspaper follow consistency in language? / [CO5]
  • Consistency in language helps maintain clarity and readability throughout the newspaper.
  • It ensures uniform style, avoids confusion among readers, and enhances professionalism
  • and credibility. Consistent language also strengthens the identity of the newspaper.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain why white space is important in the layout of editorial pages.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain why white space is important in the layout of editorial pages. / [CO5]
  • White space improves readability by preventing overcrowding of text and images. It gives
  • visual balance to the page, helps readers focus on content, and creates a clean and
  • professional appearance for editorial pages.

questions.question: Explain skyline headline
questions.solution_html:
• Explain skyline headline. / [CO5]
  • A skyline headline is a headline style in which the first line extends across the full width of
  • the page, while the remaining lines are shorter. It is commonly used for major or lead news
  • stories to attract readers’ attention.

• Explain linguistic challenge in translating news content. / [CO6]
  • Linguistic challenges arise due to differences in grammar, vocabulary, idioms, and cultural
  • meanings between languages. Translating news accurately is difficult because the original
  • meaning, tone, and context must be preserved without distortion or bias.

questions.question: Explain the different functions of journalism
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the different functions of journalism. / [CO1]
  • Journalism performs several important functions in society. Its main function is to inform
  • the public by providing accurate and timely news. Journalism also educates people by
  • explaining social, political, and economic issues. Another key function is acting as a
  • watchdog by monitoring those in power and exposing corruption and injustice. Journalism
  • also provides a platform for public opinion through editorials and columns. Through these
  • functions, journalism supports democracy and public awareness.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: illustrate the structure of the inverted pyramid with an example
questions.solution_html:
• Illustrate the structure of the inverted pyramid with an example. / [CO3]
  • The inverted pyramid is a news writing structure where the most important information
  • appears at the beginning of the story. The lead answers the key questions such as who,
  • what, when, where, why, and how. Supporting details follow in the middle, while less
  • important background information comes at the end.
  • For example, in an accident report, the lead mentions the accident, location, time, and
  • casualties, followed by details and background information.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the main departments of a newspaper and their core responsibilities. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the main departments of a newspaper and their core responsibilities.
  • / [CO3, CO4]
  • A newspaper consists of several departments. The editorial department edits news, writes
  • editorials, and decides content. The reporting department gathers news from the field. The
  • advertising department manages advertisements and revenue. The circulation department
  • handles distribution, and the production department manages layout, design, and printing.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe how a journalist should handle difficult or controversial questions during an interview
questions.solution_html:
• Describe how a journalist should handle difficult or controversial questions
  • during an interview. / [CO4]
  • A journalist should remain calm, polite, and professional while asking difficult questions.
  • Questions should be factual, relevant, and unbiased. The journalist must listen carefully,
  • avoid arguments, and maintain ethical standards such as fairness and accuracy during the
  • interview.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Reporters are eyes and ears of a news organization. Illustrate your answer explaining the role and responsibilities of a reporter. / [CO3, CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• “Reporters are the eyes and ears of a news organization. ” Explain the role and
  • responsibilities of a reporter. / [CO3, CO4]
  • Reporters are called the eyes and ears of a news organization because they collect
  • firsthand information directly from the field. They identify newsworthy events, attend press
  • conferences, conduct interviews, and observe situations. Reporters must verify facts,
  • ensure accuracy, and maintain objectivity in their reports. They follow ethical principles
  • such as truth, fairness, accountability, and respect for privacy. By reporting issues that
  • affect society and holding authorities accountable, reporters play an important role in
  • democracy.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the meaning, origin, and evolution of journalism [15x1 = 15]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the meaning, origin, and evolution of journalism. / [CO1]
  • Journalism is the process of collecting, verifying, and presenting news and information to
  • the public. It originated from early forms of communication such as town criers and
  • handwritten newsletters. With the invention of the printing press, newspapers developed.
  • Journalism later expanded through radio and television. In the modern era, digital media
  • and online platforms have transformed journalism, making news faster and more
  • accessible while maintaining its core values.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
